signal: Minitab climbed to #17 on G2's 2026 Best Data Analytics Software list, acquired Effex for AI-assisted design of experiments, and partnered with the UK Manufacturing Technology Centre.

email.body1:
Tom, saw Minitab jumped to #17 on G2's 2026 data analytics list and added Effex for AI-assisted design of experiments.

That momentum plus the MTC partnership usually surfaces more global enterprise accounts than the team can cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Minitab off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tom, quick follow-up for Minitab.

New recognition and the Effex story fill the funnel, but most enterprise teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to convert it. The gap shows up late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your global enterprise patch needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tom, last bit of proof for Minitab.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Minitab's reply rate likely compares to other analytics vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tom, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a global enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to Minitab either way.
